description:
Port test/extensions-discovery.test.ts (~29 test cases). Exercises:
- Direct .ex file discovery in extensions/ directory
- Subdirectory discovery via index module
- mix.exs / config-based extension paths
- Fallback hierarchy for entry points
- Error reporting (invalid code, missing exports, init failures)
- Non-recursive discovery (one level only)
- Tool, command, renderer, handler, shortcut, flag registration from discovered extensions
- Mixed discovery (direct files + subdirectories)

Upstream uses tmp dirs with .ts/.js files; Elixir equivalent uses compiled modules or Code.eval_file. Loader.ex exists but likely needs filesystem discovery additions.
title: Port extensions-discovery tests (filesystem loading, fallback hierarchy)
